text_block_list.text:
With a long day's work behind me, I allow
my mind to wander a bit. As it would turn
out, I haven't been able to forget about
Manhattan
Cafe.

I make to leave my room and head for the
track, not knowing who, or
what, I will
find.
Click, clack.

The door doesn't budge. No matter how
much I twist and turn the
knob, it refuses
to open.

Knowing that shouldn't be the case, I
tense up my shoulder and ram the door. It
gives way this time, and on the other side
I'm greeted
by...
No one.

I convince myself that the door fixture
itself is to blame, and make my
way down
to the track without much of a second
thought.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've been running after you...
ever since I
was little... Why... can't I
ever catch up?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...How are you able to accelerate through
corners like that?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
How... do you maintain that form? It's as
elegant as willow branches
swaying in the
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...You're just... so incredible.
But even so...
I'm definitely going to
catch up with you
someday...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...So I'm going to keep running. And
running... No matter how long it
takes...

Manhattan Cafe's silhouette melts into the
shadowy reaches of the track. She soon
re-emerges onto the final straightaway
with an
incredible burst of speed.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

Her jet-black hair does well to keep her
concealed in the murky darkness, but she's
able to make her presence known with an

explosion of speed.

What do you think? That ability of hers is
quite impressive, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, surprised to see me? I'm sure your
blood pressure spiked a fair bit just now.
I'd love to get a pulse reading, but there
are other
matters at hand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I assume that you are one of the new
trainers looking for someone to
scout. Or
perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You are a trespassing rascal, spying on
Umamusume late at night. I
would be
obligated to report you, of course.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well that's good to hear.
Caught your attention, has she?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I wonder what the source of that
curiosity could be. Is it her
abilities, or
have you noticed some manner of strange
phenomena that seemingly stem from her?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No matter, I suppose. You'd best speak
with her directly rather than
gawk from
afar. Time is finite, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And while I'd be interested in observing
how she chooses to engage
with you, I'm
afraid I must get back to my research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but allow me to impart one piece of
advice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Be assertive in your proposal. You'll find
that she can be surprisingly
compliant.
What was that all about?

"Strange phenomena," though. Has she
also experienced such after
interacting
with Manhattan Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yes... it is.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I can see her better... at night.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Do you... have any business with me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: With my friend.

I glance around the empty track, unable to
spot anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You won't be able to see her... No one
can, no matter how hard they
look...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So please...
don't concern yourself with it.
You really... shouldn't.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm the only one... who ever notices her.
She... she remains far away,
even from
me...

I take her word for it,
but what could that
possibly mean? A "friend"
that only she
can see?

Is she talking about something like a
ghost?
InCorRecT

No one is around but the two of us.
I can't claim to have heard a
voice, but my mind
has somehow been infiltrated with an
answer to my query.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Do you find me... "creepy"?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Nothing... Forget I asked.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

Manhattan Cafe gives me a slight bow,
and walks off.

I cannot deny that I do seem to be
experiencing strange phenomena.
Could it
have something to do with this "friend" of
hers?

There's certainly a lot on my mind, but
more than anything, I cannot
stop thinking
about her amazing running earlier.
